question: Can exact SGLang v0.5.15 express the frozen load-adaptive depth rule coherently across NGRAM production, target-row packing, attention metadata, acceptance, KV movement, and CUDA-graph shape, rather than repeating the prior H200 consumer-only truncation?
why_now: The fresh packed-mask endpoint is an independent paid direct lane. A zero-provider mechanism lane can use the free researcher slot to decide whether the strongest remaining acceptance-derived opportunity deserves a future exact H100 component. The prior H200 negative is scoped to an incoherent partial representation and must not be transferred without source-level analysis.

prior_h200_negative_compact.scope: The candidate exposed six consumer rows while NgramCorpus.batch_get remained a fixed-depth-12 producer. It produced 0/8 exact target-prediction prefixes, 0/8 exact accepted/bonus rows, one changed accepted-draft count, eight HTTP 500 responses, and a subsequent CUDA illegal memory access.

research_contract.failure_reconstruction: Extract only decision-bearing files from the bound H200 compact artifact. Identify the first violated producer-to-consumer shape or ownership invariant; do not relabel the illegal access as a hardware effect.
research_contract.causal_chain: Trace depth through corpus lookup, draft-token flattening, seq_lens, positions, attention masks, target rows, accept_indices, accepted bonus tokens, KV indices and movement, graph capture/replay, and scheduler settlement for batch sizes 7, 8, and a permuted batch.
research_contract.candidate_scope: At most one materially different representation is allowed. It must change every source location required to keep producer, metadata, consumer, and graph shape coherent. A consumer-only slice, padding disguise, threshold sweep, or reuse of the rejected H200 patch is forbidden.
research_contract.oracle: Provide positive depth-12 and depth-6 fixtures, the 7-to-8 boundary, request-order permutation, mixed completion, and fail-closed inconsistent-shape fixtures. The oracle must prove row counts, per-request slices, positions, masks, accept-index offsets, accepted/bonus ownership, and KV transitions without CUDA.
research_contract.quantitative_bound: From measured acceptance and exact geometry, report eliminated target rows and an analytical attention/metadata work bound by load bucket. Label it analytical; do not infer milliseconds, endpoint throughput, economics, or H100 speedup.
research_contract.terminal: Persist ADAPTIVE_DEPTH_H100_RESULT.json and ADAPTIVE_DEPTH_H100_DECISION.md with exactly one classification: source_complete_h100_component_ready, transferred_negative_source_infeasible, or indeterminate_missing_required_source. A ready result must name every edited symbol, bind the project-local source hashes and fixture outputs, and preregister the smallest future checkpoint-free exact H100 component. It does not authorize that component.

budgets.local_compute: At most 45 CPU-minutes and 8 GiB RAM; no CUDA.

prohibitions: Do not create, claim, inspect, SSH to, or mutate a provider resource or GPU bench.
Do not inspect, read, poll, or depend on the active packed-mask endpoint project.
Do not replay any historical endpoint, sentinel, or candidate endpoint request.
Do not sweep the frozen threshold or draft depths.
Do not repeat or lightly rename the rejected H200 consumer-only truncation.
Do not claim semantic equivalence from row-count arithmetic alone.
Do not infer H100 latency, whole-request speed, sustainable economics, or production readiness.
Do not authorize or launch a future H100 component.
